items.name: 01-hero
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, real estate photo, realistic proportions, cosy and calm, no people, no text, no labels, no logos, no brand names, high detail. Palette: warm terracotta, cream, sage green, white oak, soft caramel. A small British double bedroom on a winter afternoon: walls painted a warm muted terracotta, an upholstered cream headboard, layered bedding in cream linen with a chunky knitted throw and sage cushions, a white oak bedside table with a ceramic lamp glowing warm, thick lined curtains half drawn at a sash window with soft grey sky outside, a large textured wool rug under the bed extending well past both sides. No candles, no fireplace. Eye-level view.

items.name: 03-layers
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, realistic proportions, cosy and calm, no people, no text, no labels, no logos, high detail. Palette: cream, oatmeal, sage green, caramel. Close view of a made double bed with layered textiles: a thick white duvet in a cream linen cover, a waffle blanket folded across the foot of the bed, a chunky knitted throw, and four cushions in sage, oatmeal and caramel against an upholstered headboard. Soft daylight.

items.name: 04-curtains
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, realistic proportions, cosy and calm, no people, no text, no labels, no logos, high detail. Palette: warm cream, sage green, white oak. A bedroom window with heavy lined sage green curtains hung from a pole fixed well above and wider than the window frame, falling to just touch the floor, closed most of the way at dusk, with a white radiator under the window left completely uncovered and the curtains ending above it on the sides, not draped over it. Warm lamp light in the room.
